WebsiteSubmission.title: WebsiteSubmission
WebsiteSubmission.description: Stores website URLs submitted by authenticated users from the hero get started input.

uid.description: UID of the authenticated user who submitted the website URL.

websiteUrl.description: The website domain or URL entered by the user.

status.description: Processing status of the website submission.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the website URL was submitted.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores website URL submissions linked to the authenticated user.
